promo-never-attach.title: Never attach your lead magnet #shorts
promo-never-attach.description: Attachments are one of the most reliable ways to land in spam. Mailchimp's own docs say they can slow or stop bulk delivery - which is why it hosts your file for you instead, capped at 10 MB. Host it, link to it. Full lead magnet tutorial on the channel.

promo-one-field-form.title: Your opt-in form needs one field #shorts
promo-one-field-form.description: Every extra field costs you sign-ups, and you do not need their phone number for a PDF. Put the promise above the field in the same words as the cover, and label the button with what they get - not "Submit". Full lead magnet tutorial on the channel.
